services.desc: Captain Brandon is ready to get you out on the water and help you create the fishing journey of a lifetime. Hands-on fishing: rod in hand, lots of casting and reeling. Learning various techniques based on the target fish species. Prices do not include Gratuity. Gratuity is not expected nor required but is greatly appreciated! Things happen that we can not control. Deposits can be refunded or credited towards a future trip. Deposits are non-refundable within 14 days of your trip date. The Captain reserves the right to cancel a trip.
